organism.common_name: Miocene Stickleback Chronospecies I (Full Pelvic Girdle, T=0 kyr)

phenomenon_scale.label: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength
phenomenon_scale.note: 33 µm detail rung. Distinct from the 2.3 mm organ-scale sibling slot 1207.

equations.kinetics: du/dt = D_u laplacian(u) + a - u + u^2 v; dv/dt = D_v laplacian(v) + b - u^2 v
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = largest real eigenvalue of J - k^2 diag(D_u, D_v)
equations.ocellus_readout: P = P0 + A(t) cos(k_img * r - m * theta + phi(t)), m = 2, A(t) taken from RMS(u)

parameters.parameter_status: D_u and D_v/D_u were solved so argmax_k sigma(k) = 2*pi/32.86 um^-1 on this Jacobian. They are not the 2.3 mm sibling slot's parameters.

chronospecies_delta.rule: At fixed diffusion ratio, lambda scales as sqrt(D_u). The successor is the same Jacobian with D_u multiplied by (41.50/32.86)^2. Pass 1 records that analytic lengthening; a numerical successor integration is a remediation item.

empirical_claims.statement: The Truckee Formation G. doryssus series moves toward a reduced pelvic optimum over roughly 22 kyr.
empirical_claims.used_for: age order and pelvic states of the chronoseries

empirical_claims.statement: Selection is inferable on the fossil stickleback pelvic phenotype.
Pitx1 contributes to pelvic reduction in this fossil lineage.
empirical_claims.used_for: developmental locus named as the living/fossil parallel, not as a measured wavelength

empirical_claims.statement: The cellular-detail wavelength for this slot is 32.86 um (3.286e-05 m) at 10.02 Ma. Bell, Hunt, and Stuart did not publish that pigment spacing.

specimen.license_note: Project species-gallery canonical image for this chronospecies. Fallback used after no CC Truckee Formation 33 um thin section was located. Scale bar 100 um = 111 px.

claim_boundary_summary.reported_in_source: Pelvic reduction chronoseries in Truckee G. doryssus; Pitx1 and Eda parallels in extant sticklebacks; Turing dispersion relation; chromatophore RD in zebrafish.
claim_boundary_summary.reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg field on a 280 um patch with lambda_c = 32.86 um, equal-diffusion ablation, D_u sweep, and an m=2 ocellus readout whose amplitude follows RMS(u).
claim_boundary_summary.does_not_claim: That Bell or Hunt measured a 33 um pigment wavelength, or that the gallery spiral is a fossil thin section.
